title.value: Head2Toe: Utilizing Intermediate Representations for Better Transfer Learning
title.justification: The paper focuses on a method called 'Head2Toe' which leverages intermediate representations within neural networks to improve transfer learning, making it central to the research presented.
title.quote: We propose a method, Head-to-Toe probing (H EAD 2T OE ), that selects features from all layers of the source model to train a classification head for the target domain.

extractions.description: The paper introduces 'Head2Toe', a method for transfer learning that optimizes performance by utilizing intermediate representations from all layers of a neural network instead of just the last layer. The method is shown to match or surpass traditional fine-tuning in accuracy while significantly reducing computational costs.

primary_category.justification: The paper focuses on transfer learning methodologies, specifically in machine learning model efficiency, which is not explicitly tied to eco-responsible AI applications or categories.
primary_category.quote: In this work, we propose and explore methods for selecting useful features from all layers of a pretrained net, including the embedding, and then applying the L INEAR transfer approach to the constructed representation.

secondary_categories.justification: Although not the main focus, improved model efficiency and reduced computational cost can contribute to more sustainable computing practices, indirectly impacting climate mitigation.
secondary_categories.quote: Head2Toe matches performance obtained with fine-tuning on average while reducing training and storage cost a hundred fold or more.

primary_sub_category.justification: The sub-category is not specified because the paper does not address a specific eco-responsible impact or application directly, focusing instead on transfer learning and computational efficiency.
primary_sub_category.quote: Thus, so long as fine-tuning produces small displacements Δwij, the F INE T UNING solution for a given input x can be approximated by a linear combination of all features in the network.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: Reducing computational and storage cost in machine learning models contributes to energy-efficient operations, which is analogous to energy efficiency efforts in buildings.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: Head2Toe […] performance obtained with fine-tuning on average while reducing training and storage cost a hundred fold or more.
